objective: Allow mobile ChatGPT analysis to consume fresh Yuanta JNU data without storing broker credentials in GitHub repository content.
hard_rules: Broker account/password/certificate private key/PFX password must never be committed to GitHub, even in a private repository.
Password hashes are not usable for Yuanta Login(account,password) and therefore cannot replace the original secret.
Do not store reversible encrypted broker credentials in the repository together with the decryption key.
GitHub may store code and deployment configuration; the executable secret must live in a secret manager or OS credential store on the runtime host.
Quote-only bridge only; order placement/modification/cancellation remains prohibited.

secret_options: GitHub Actions repository/environment secrets for bounded workflow jobs
external secret manager such as Azure Key Vault
Windows Credential Manager on a trusted Windows runtime
prohibited: password hashes presented as reusable login credentials
secret decryption keys committed beside encrypted blobs

runtime_options.requirement: Home PC must remain powered on, online, and Yuanta runtime healthy.
runtime_options.note: A GitHub self-hosted runner does not solve the user's offline-home-PC case.

reason: GitHub-hosted runners are ephemeral per job.
Yuanta DLL/runtime/package must be installed every run or restored securely.
Continuous market-data streaming is not an appropriate always-on Actions workload.
Yuanta cloud-host login/network entitlement has not been proven.
runtime_options.allowed_future_use: Bounded read-only probe only after vendor/runtime feasibility is proven.

requirements: Yuanta quote entitlement verified from that VM
secrets stored in Windows Credential Manager or cloud secret vault
strong authentication, IP/rate controls and audit logs

preferred_architecture.credentials: Windows Credential Manager or cloud secret vault
preferred_architecture.github_actions: deployment/health checks only, not the live quote stream

activation_gate: Verify Yuanta terms permit the intended remote/cloud runtime.
Verify SPARK DLL runs on the target Windows VM.
Verify login callback MsgCode=0001 from the VM without exposing credentials.
Verify exact OSE JNU contract callbacks and freshness.
Verify no order method is exposed.
